dhpak2.9:3.1: Ekasmiñhi sāvatthito avidūre nigamagāme jātasaṃvaḍḍho eko
dhpak2.9:3.3: “nigamavāsitissatthero nāma appiccho santuṭṭho pavivitto āraddhavīriyo”ti paññāyi.
dhpak2.9:4.3: asadisadānaṃ karontepi neva āgacchatī”ti kathaṃ samuṭṭhāpetvā satthu ārocayiṃsu.
dhpak2.9:5.3: “natthi, bhante, mayhaṃ ñātisaṃsaggo, ahaṃ ete manusse
dhpak2.9:5.4: nissāya ajjhoharaṇīyamattaṃ āhāraṃ labhāmi lūkhe vā paṇīte
dhpak2.9:5.5: vā. Yāpanamatte laddhe puna kiṃ āhārapariyesanenāti na
dhpak2.9:5.6: gacchāmi, ñātīhi pana me saṃsaggo nāma natthi, bhante”ti vutte
dhpak2.9:5.7: satthā pakatiyāpi tassa ajjhāsayaṃ vijānanto – “sādhu sādhu, bhikkhū”ti tassa sādhukāraṃ datvā,
dhpak2.9:5.9: tvaṃ mādisaṃ ācariyaṃ labhitvā appiccho ahosi.
dhpak2.9:5.10: Ayañhi appicchatā nāma mama tanti, mama
dhpak2.9:5.11: paveṇī”ti vatvā bhikkhūhi yācito atītaṃ āhari –
dhpak2.9:6.3: Tatreko suvarājā attano nivāsarukkhassa phalesu khīṇesu yaṃ yadeva
dhpak2.9:6.4: avasiṭṭhaṃ hoti aṅkuro vā pattaṃ vā taco vā, taṃ taṃ khāditvā
dhpak2.9:6.5: gaṅgāyaṃ pānīyaṃ pivitvā paramappiccho santuṭṭho hutvā aññattha na gacchati.
dhpak2.9:6.8: vīmaṃsanatthaṃ attano ānubhāvena taṃ rukkhaṃ sukkhāpesi.
dhpak2.9:6.9: Rukkho obhaggo khāṇumatto chiddāvachiddova hutvā vāte paharante
dhpak2.9:6.10: ākoṭito viya saddaṃ nicchārento aṭṭhāsi. Tassa chiddehi cuṇṇāni nikkhamanti.
dhpak2.9:6.11: Suvarājā tāni khāditvā gaṅgāyaṃ pānīyaṃ pivitvā aññattha
dhpak2.9:7.2: kathāpetvā varamassa datvā udumbaraṃ amataphalaṃ katvā āgamissāmī”ti
dhpak2.9:7.6: nisīditvā tena saddhiṃ kathento imaṃ gāthamāha –
dhpak2.9:8.2: Kasmā nu sukkhe koḷāpe, suvassa nirato mano”ti. (jā. 1.9.30);
dhpak2.9:9.2: Aṭṭhuppattiyeva hi tattha ca idha ca nānā, sesaṃ tādisameva.
dhpak2.9:10.2: sakko ānando ahosi, suvarājā ahamevā”ti vatvā,
dhpak2.9:10.3: “evaṃ, bhikkhave, appicchatā nāmesā mama tanti, mama paveṇī,
dhpak2.9:10.4: anacchariyā mama puttassa nigamavāsitissassa mādisaṃ ācariyaṃ labhitvā appicchatā,
dhpak2.9:10.5: bhikkhunā nāma nigamavāsitissena viya appiccheneva bhavitabbaṃ. Evarūpo hi bhikkhu abhabbo
dhpak2.9:10.6: samathavipassanādhammehi vā maggaphalehi vā parihānāya, aññadatthu nibbānasseva santike hotī”ti vatvā
dhpak2.9:12.1: Tattha abhabbo parihānāyāti so evarūpo bhikkhu samathavipassanādhammehi vā
dhpak2.9:12.2: maggaphalehi vā parihānāya abhabbo, nāpi pattehi parihāyati, na appattāni na pāpuṇāti.
